description: Round 2 of the full-parity phase (escaping family, seeds 7001-7005, 10000 cases): the one new mismatch cluster, minimised, with oracle probes of its variants. CR bytes that string escapes put into the generated PHP shift PHP's line count (accepted deviation D2). Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical.

vectors.note: minimised from esc-7003-959 (2 raw cases): the `\x0d` in block b1 shifts the macro compiled after it

known_mismatch.reason: Accepted deviation D2 (reference/deviations.md, Engine: lone CR bytes in the generated PHP): an escape sequence (`\r`, `\x0d`, `\15`) puts a CR byte into a string literal, Compiler::string() (TWIG/src/Compiler.php:144, addcslashes() of NUL, tab, `"`, `$` and `\` only) writes it raw into the PHP source, and PHP's scanner counts it as a line break while the Compiler counts only `\n` for getDebugInfo(); Error::guess() then maps the failing PHP line to a later `// line N` marker that Twig wrote in the middle of a line (the print of a filter call). twig-rs attributes lines by markers and has no PHP line counts. Raw CR bytes in the template are normalized before compiling and do not shift anything.
